before_fix_evidence.reason: Actual KEY buffered rows and VarType8 pass in all four preparation/execution profile pairs, then descriptor assertions show Dynamic. Dynamic/Dynamic and Dynamic/NULL lose nullable Text metadata; named/derived UNION leaves its numeric arm unconverted. These failures demonstrate the fixed inference gap, not a runtime concatenation answer correction.

bound_group_diagnostic.result: Both bound group profiles Dynamic while ordinary buffered execution in both arithmetic modes returns asserted Text10/20/150 and VarType8. Temporary diagnostic removed; not counted in accepted56.

contracts: Successful ampersand evaluation is Text/retained String or both-NULL. Dynamic is conservatively possibly NULL; known nonnullable convertible peers establish nonnullable Text. Null/Null and explicit unsupported-family metadata retain existing handling.

Runtime String conversions, eager errors, number/date formatting policies, raw publication and declaration provenance are unchanged. This narrows successful-result descriptors without admitting Dynamic group keys or changing mixed addition.
Binding reads no source rows and activates no formatting/comparison provider. Paired metadata flows to named/derived and UNION consumers through existing propagation.

excluded_attempts.reason: New test used unwrap_err on Result<QueryResult,...>, but QueryResult intentionally lacks Debug. Replaced only error extraction with err().unwrap(); no test ran.
Diagnostic command placed --exact before the Cargo test separator; Cargo refused the flag and ran no tests. Corrected command appears in the diagnostic evidence.

validation_limits: Focused buffered/metadata tests have no dependency on progressive Text execution; worktree also contains that separate upcoming implementation. Parent stages this metadata prerequisite as a separate logical change.
